title: Rape and molestation cases in 2025 and where they happen
asked: Ms Gho Sze Kee asked whether the rise in rape and molestation cases in 2025 was mainly driven by offenders known to victims, for a breakdown of where the cases occurred (domestic, workplace or educational settings), and whether targeted interventions in those settings are being strengthened.
response: Mr Goh Pei Ming said outrage of modesty cases rose by 104, from 1,427 to 1,531, and rape cases rose by 78, from 401 to 479, between 2024 and 2025. Most rape cases and more than half of outrage of modesty cases involved offenders known to the victims, and those proportions have been stable over the last five years. Of the 2025 total, about 33% occurred in residential premises, 18% in commercial premises and 3% in educational institutions. He said ministries have measures to prevent offending, encourage reporting and support victims, including teaching students to seek help from trusted adults, specialist centres for domestic settings, and Police victim care services.
